title: Detangled schema-emitter regression playbook for constrained-decoder stream + toolcall interleave
creator: Ayesha Kaur
description: Create a reproducible regression harness and playbook that validates end-to-end behavior when streaming JSON-mode outputs are interleaved with tool/function calls under constrained decoding. The goal is to surface subtle failure modes (partial emits, toolcall corruption, schema drift) and provide deterministic remediation steps and signal thresholds for rollout gating.
acceptance_criteria: A test harness that can replay 100+ synthetic scenarios and 50 captured real-world traces with seedable randomness
Deterministic detection of three failure classes: truncated JSON fragments, toolcall payload corruption, and schema-version mismatches
Automated post-failure artifact collection (raw stream, reassembled sequence, decoder logits snapshot) and linkable to CI failure for triage
Runbook entries for automatic fallback: soft-relaxation, rewind-and-retry, and canary rollback; validated in a non-prod Dedicated cluster
Metrics/alerts defined and validated in Console: contract-violation-rate, partial-emits-per-minute, toolcall-parse-errors with example dashboard panels
test_matrix: Stream modality: full-stream flush vs incremental chunked emits (sizes: 8B, 256B, 2KB)
Toolcall interleave patterns: single immediate, nested tool-call sequence, and delayed async callback
Decoder mode: strict constrained decode, soft-relax (field-level drop), and permissive fallback
Model variants: base-16k, large-32k sequence length distributions; quantized (int8) and float16 kernels
Serving path: hosted API, dedicated pool with burst, private deploy simulating higher network jitter
test_cases: TC-01: Partial JSON fragment emitted, stream ends unexpectedly; expect: graceful partial-recovery by buffer + re-request when decoder has checkpoint, alert fired
TC-02: Interleaved toolcall where tool output contains stray tokens that look like JSON delimiters; expect: toolcall-sanitizer to isolate payload and schema check to fail fast
TC-03: Schema version mismatch (client expects v2 fields) in middle of streamed response; expect: detector to mark response incompatible and route to permissive decoder with telemetry capture
TC-04: KV-cache eviction mid-stream causing token misalignment; expect: run reassembly replay to show shifted tokens, and fallback to model-variant with full-prefix recompute

TC-05: Batching-induced ordering inversion on high-throughput dedicated pool producing out-of-order partial emits; expect: sequence numbers to detect and reconstruct ordering, otherwise circuit-breaker fires
steps: 1) Implement harness module (tests/schema_emitter_harness) that can synthesize streams and inject toolcall frames as separate protocol events
2) Integrate harness with the decoder shim to snapshot logits and prefix cache state at configurable checkpoints
3) Add postmortem collection hook that uploads artifacts to S3 and annotates the CI failure with links
4) Create console dashboard panels and alert rules; validate thresholds with synthetic fault injection
5) Run the full matrix in a non-prod Dedicated cluster and record flaky scenarios; create follow-up ENG tickets for runtime fixes
6) Draft runbook with remediation play (soft-relax -> rewind -> rollback) and owner rotations; attach to incident playbooks
expected_outcomes: Comprehensive failure taxonomy and reproducible repros for each class
CI gating that fails on regression >0.1% contract-violation-rate during canary traffic
Clear telemetry and dashboarding so SRE/Oncall can triage within 15 minutes
Runbook validated by tabletop exercise with oncall and runtime engineers
